messages:
alice: Quick OKR milestone roundup — want a short status for these three: Engine perf, Canary rollout, Product integrations. Reply with: shipped/slipped, owner, ETA, blocker (if any). Aim: decide canary A/B by EOD Friday.
ben: Engine perf — shipped. Owner: ben. ETA: shipped yesterday (merged). Notes: micro-batching PR reduced p95/p99 across our burst workload (~18% p99 improvement). PR: https://git.rd/repo/pulls/4321 :rocket: 
carla: Canary rollout — slipped. Owner: carla. ETA: Thu next week. Blocker: GPU driver mismatch on ~10% of eu-west nodes during canary deploy, causing OOMs. Filed infra ticket infra#1245. Will re-run with pinned image tomorrow.
david: I can look at infra#1245 now. Likely drift from image rebuilds; I think rebuilding the runtime image w/ pinned driver will fix. @carla please paste the failing container logs.
carla: logs pasted below:
```
E0321 14:12:01 container.go:212] eviction: lru-kv-cache oom at step 1789
2026-03-21T14:12:01Z runtime: kernel module mismatch: nvidia_driver 535 vs node 534
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/inference/serve.py", line 402, in step
    kv_cache.append(tokens)
MemoryError
```
carla: Also tagged the failing nodes with label 'gpu:unstable' so prod splits away from them for now.
ops-bot: Deploy failed: canary-deploy/eu-west (task id dpl-789) — see logs https://deploy.rd/logs/dpl-789 
emily: Integrations — partial shipped. Owner: emily. ETA: Tues next week for full rollout. Blocker: 3rd-party auth vendor is doing schema changes; holding final QA. We have a feature flag ready to flip once vendor confirms.
ben: Quick followups: I want perf dashboard updated with the new p99 baseline before we flip canary to A/B. Owner: ben -> ETA: tomorrow noon.
carla: Ping on code review: @ben can you review my follow-up PR that pins the image? https://git.rd/repo/pulls/4330
ben: @carla on review queue now, will try to merge by EOD.
david: Image rebuild started (jenkins job #6623). ETA ~3h. I'll post a status update here when it's done.
emily: I'll ask vendor for final ETA and post in this thread. If vendor slips >3d, we'll toggle fallback flow.
alice: Thanks — action items: 1) ben update dashboard (tomorrow), 2) carla rerun canary + update rollout plan (next Thu ETA), 3) david finish image rebuild (in progress), 4) emily confirm vendor ETA. If any item slips beyond Fri, call it out here so we can escalate. :thumbsup: 
carla: Noted. I'll also add a short rollback playbook to the canary doc in case the remaining nodes misbehave.
ben: One more — low-priority: pinging for review on perf-test harness PR #4335, tagging @carla and @david.
carla: saw it, will take a look after image rebuild.
david: Image rebuild done, pushed image tag rd/runtime:2026-03-21-6623. Starting a small smoke canary now.
carla: smoke canary looks good for 10/10 requests. Kicking off broader canary to ~20% traffic.
emily: Noted, I'll prep comms for product stakeholders once canary reaches 50%.
alice: Perfect — I'll consolidate these notes for the exec sync doc. Thanks everyone.
ben: :thumbsup:
